scope: Personally read all three complete original reports before opening detailed004/088 proposed audit. Candidate indices/targets and proposed directions were known from triage message. This is targeted independent adjudication, not another whole-batch blinded pass.

records.source_evidence: Mild fraying articular cartilage of patella, in favor of grade 2 chondromalacia.
records.reason: Mild cartilage fraying directly describes a low-grade surface lesion; the negative does not require choosing a meaning for the adjacent unnamed grade2. No deeper PF cartilage defect is stated. Retain below_threshold rather than blanket-mask all gradeII references.

records.source_evidence: Heterogenous signal intensity of patellar cartilage with mild fraying surface, R/O grade 2 patellar chondromalacia.
records.reason: Mild surface fraying is directly observed and is below the high-grade cartilage-loss threshold. The R/O hedge applies to the grade2 diagnostic interpretation; it does not erase the explicit mild surface finding or introduce high-grade loss. No separate deeper PF defect stated.

records.source_evidence:
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios de distribución difusa de la
articulación patelofemoral.
records.reason: The PF sentence explicitly describes full-thickness ulcers with diffuse distribution and secondary osseous change. This supplies high-grade depth and qualitative extent under the same report-level diffuse-high-grade inference used elsewhere. It is separate from mixed partial/full tibiofemoral findings; the PF conclusion grade3/4 does not contradict full-depth findings. Accept as a weak qualitative extent inference, not a measured proof of a contiguous>=1cm lesion.
